t: The Architecture of Forever: Your Round-Robin Blueprint for AI Mastery
s: This article outlines the 'Architecture of Forever' and 'Round-Robin Philosophy' for AI mastery, advocating 'AI on Rails' via linear workflows (like Jupyter Notebooks) over inefficient 'Agentic AI'. It champions durable, open-source tools (Nix, ZeroMQ) and continuous skill refinement for building immutable development environments.
